architecture.ad_translate.name: Translator
architecture.ad_translate.body: Maps the outside model to ours and back.

architecture.adapter.name: adapter
architecture.adapter.body: Use when an outside system must be reached without its model leaking into ours.

architecture.calls.name: calls
architecture.calls.body: One component asks another to do something.

architecture.component.name: component
architecture.component.body: A piece of a system somebody owns and a technology implements.

architecture.database.name: database
architecture.database.body: A component that stores state other components read.

architecture.decision.name: decision
architecture.decision.body: A recorded choice, drawn like a note.

architecture.document.name: document
architecture.document.body: A page read as a document.

architecture.external.name: external
architecture.external.body: A component outside this system, drawn with a dashed border.

architecture.integrates.name: integrates
architecture.integrates.body: A component reaches a system outside its own.

architecture.layered_service.name: layered service
architecture.layered_service.body: Use when one service owns its rules and its store, and every request should meet them in the same order.

architecture.ls_api.name: API
architecture.ls_api.body: Accepts a request and hands it to the domain logic.

architecture.ls_logic.name: Domain logic
architecture.ls_logic.body: Applies the rules. It does not talk to the store.

architecture.ls_repo.name: Repository
architecture.ls_repo.body: Reads and writes the store for the domain logic.

architecture.n_ad_client.name: The only part that speaks the outside protocol.

architecture.n_ad_port.name: Accepts a request already in our model.

architecture.n_ad_translate.name: Maps the outside model to ours and back.

architecture.n_adapter.name: Keeps an outside system's model out of ours: everything crossing is translated in one place.

architecture.n_layered_service.name: Requests enter at the API, rules live in one layer, storage is reached only through the repository.

architecture.n_ls_api.name: The only way in: it accepts the request and does no work of its own.

architecture.n_ls_logic.name: The rules live here, and nowhere else in the service.

architecture.n_ls_repo.name: Reads and writes the store; nothing else touches it.

architecture.n_ls_store.name: The service's state, reached only through the repository.

architecture.n_ob_api.name: The only way in: it accepts the request and does no work of its own.

architecture.n_ob_logic.name: Writes the state change and the event in one transaction.

architecture.n_ob_outbox.name: The events, written beside the state they announce.

architecture.n_ob_relay.name: Polls the outbox and publishes each event at least once.

architecture.n_ob_repo.name: Reads and writes the store; nothing else touches it.

architecture.n_ob_store.name: The service's state, reached only through the repository.

architecture.n_outbox_service.name: A state change and the event announcing it are written together, so neither is lost.

architecture.ob_api.name: API
architecture.ob_api.body: Accepts a request and hands it to the domain logic.

architecture.ob_logic.name: Domain logic
architecture.ob_logic.body: Applies the rules and writes the announcement in the same transaction.

architecture.ob_outbox.name: Outbox
architecture.ob_outbox.body: Holds the events written in the same transaction as the state change.

architecture.ob_relay.name: Outbox relay
architecture.ob_relay.body: Publishes each outbox event, and retries until it has.

architecture.ob_repo.name: Repository
architecture.ob_repo.body: Reads and writes the store for the domain logic.

architecture.outbox_service.name: outbox service
architecture.outbox_service.body: Use when a state change must announce itself, and neither the change nor the announcement may be lost.

architecture.person.name: person
architecture.person.body: Someone outside the system who uses it.

architecture.publishes.name: publishes
architecture.publishes.body: A component puts a message on a queue.

architecture.queue.name: queue
architecture.queue.body: A component that carries messages from one component to another.

architecture.reads.name: reads
architecture.reads.body: A component reads what a store holds.

diagrams.class_diagram.name: class diagram
diagrams.class_diagram.body: A diagram of the definitions its references stand for, as attribute tables, and what they extend.

diagrams.message.name: message
diagrams.message.body: One participant asks another to act: a message between two steps.

diagrams.reply.name: reply
diagrams.reply.body: An answer to a message, drawn dashed.

diagrams.sequence_diagram.name: sequence diagram
diagrams.sequence_diagram.body: A grid read as time: the header row names the participants, and each row is a moment.

diagrams.swimlane.name: swimlane
diagrams.swimlane.body: A grid read as lanes: the header row names the participants, the header column the phases, and the lines between steps are drawn.

src.yaml.about.1.name: The showcase is one layer per thing mndflow draws. Read the header note, then the tied note on each block: it names the field or setting that makes the block look that way. Package on the rail draws the section in focus. Opening a folder draws its folder view; a definition, its definition view under the package and folders on its path. Definitions and structure are two trees, each with folders of its own: definitions lists the definitions, structure the layers. The workspace roots structure; a definition roots it once it holds blocks of its own. Every layer is a diagram file under samples/showcase/src; the Diagrams layers use the diagrams package.
